title: Round Table Foundation ELF research penetrating a Faraday cage

tellings.quote: frequency that can he figured out like penetrate the walls of a Faraday cage.

plain: A researcher named Greg, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells of work at the Round Table Foundation, a private research group linked to a scientist named Andrija Puharich, in the 1950s and again in the late 1970s and 1980s. According to Greg, they studied ELF, very low frequency radio waves, and found a frequency that could get through the walls of a Faraday cage, a metal enclosure built to block electrical signals. If true, it would suggest signals, or minds, could reach places thought to be sealed off.
